author: Xz3rr0
body: Definitely a Odie question but this could be happening when you go through spots of no internet. So when the internet picks back up it sees you have moved and decides that must not be possible. I have had this problem a year ago when I would go on a three hour drive then open the app when I got to my destination. The game decided I must have been spoofing as I had jumped location since moving. It's not a solution but that's my best guess. Hope it helps!

author: OrnaOdie
body: You are getting warnings because your device is reportedly using GPS mocking tools. Please try disabling any apps that may alter your GPS data, including VPNs.

author: Modangy
body:
Try to open the app before starting your drive. Disconnect from wifi, and make sure the yellow flashing bar (if present) up the top has gone away. Then you'll be fine, it won't return to your house. 

This happens when the app isn't actually running in the background. You'll show as the last place you had it actively running, until the GPS can work itself out. In my experience it takes longer if you aren't in the same spot the game last remembered

body: I have never had that happen and i drive and play on the regular. I use the option to have my gps running all the time for the game and never get a tampering warning, even when it jumps me from place to place. Try having it active all the time instead of only when you use the game and see if it goes away.
